notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-SustainedDamage PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): Backup PvE roll for sustained DPS against a single yellow-bar target in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. Cartesian Coordinate is a rapid-fire fusion rifle, which are rated F-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic being a "strict downgrade from high-impact and precision frames for boss damage". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the battery is empty as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are good by comparison with its peers - you can see them at https://destiny.report/w/3719824177/cartesian-coordinate and hopefully https://d2foundry.gg/w/3719824177 will show how weapon stats impact in-game performance when the site is back up and running. With 9 bolts to control, look for a barrel perk that helps with recoil control together with any other stat that you want to bump. Accelerated Coils improves charge time by 40ms at the cost of ×0.98 base damage or Enhanced Battery in the battery perk slot gets you to the maximum of 8 shots. While losing out to precision and high-impact frames for total boss damage, if you wanted one for ease of use, in the first trait perk slot, either Envious Arsenal refills the battery from reserves on dealing damage with both of your other weapons as part of a damage weapon rotation, or Reconstruction refills 25% of the battery every 6s (5.5s when enhanced) up to ×2 capacity when stowed or not firing. In the second column for damage, Aggregate Charge, particularly on a Prismatic build, provides a stack for each different elemental debuff up to ×3 stacks to boost damage by a max ×1.3 (×1.33 when enhanced), with each stack lasting as long as the debuff is active, or Controlled Burst reduces charge time to ×0.9 and boosts damage by ×1.2 for 2s (2.5s enhanced) after a kill or landing all the bolts in a burst. Neither origin trait is particularly useful for a boss roll - Veteran's Wisdom procs on a crit kill or 3 kills within 3s of each other to generate an 8m (9m enhanced) AoE kinetic shockwave which inflicts Exhaust on enemies. There's also Field-Tested which starts subtly but if you can stay alive to get hits and kills, you'll start to feel the boosts to Range, Stability, Handling and Reload Speed as you get to the higher stacks. If you're interested, in mathematics a Cartesian coordinate system specifies each point uniquely in a plane by a set of numerical coordinates. Recommended MW: Charge Time, with a Charge Time mod or your preferred choice to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.
